author: claude
summary: Task 011: adds the deferred-delete + undo-toast pattern (task 009's mechanism) to queue-item removal, and adds a guided-failure toast to segment retry. U5 (queue-drawer affordances) audited against TASKS.md's literal wording and found already satisfied (AppShell's queue-toggle button with a live queueCount badge) -- no code change for that part.

files.change: handleRemove(id) no longer calls api.cancelChapterGeneration/api.removeProcessingQueue immediately; it schedules the request via setTimeout(TOAST_VISIBLE_MS) tracked in a pendingRemovesRef keyed by job id, and emits a 'Removed "<title>" from queue.' toast with an Undo action that clearTimeouts the pending request (same pattern as useProjectActions.handleDeleteChapter / useVoiceManagement.handleDelete). Deviation from the task doc's literal 'exact files' list: the actual removal request lives in this hook, not GlobalQueue.tsx/QueueItem.tsx directly, so the hook needed the edit (see task file's Deviation note).

handleSegmentRetry's failure catch now also calls emitToast("Couldn't retry that segment...") in addition to the existing console.error, so a failed segment retry surfaces a user-facing, actionable message instead of a silent error (U6 guided failure recovery).

'handles removal' test rewritten for the deferred-remove + Undo-toast shape (asserts api.removeProcessingQueue is not called until TOAST_VISIBLE_MS elapses, and the toast carries an Undo action); new test for Undo cancelling the pending removal.
'calls removeProcessingQueue when a queued job is cancelled' updated to advance fake timers past TOAST_VISIBLE_MS before asserting the API call, matching the new deferred-removal behavior.
New: a failed api.generateSegments retry request surfaces a toast mentioning retry; a successful retry does not surface a toast.
